item.title: Lighting a Live Performance
item.description: Describe how stage lighting changes during a public performance and how those changes shape what spectators can see.

children.definition: The planned order in which lighting changes are triggered during a performance.
children.example: The cue sequence for the balcony scene begins with the stairway lights and ends with a spotlight on the singer.
children.translation_uz: sahna chiroqlarini oʻzgartirish uchun beriladigan signallar ketma-ketligi

children.definition: The combination of active stage lights, their colors and their brightness at a particular moment.
children.example: The opening lighting state leaves the chorus in shadow and gives the storyteller a pool of amber light.
collocations: return to the previous lighting state

children.definition: A planned moment when all stage lighting is off and the stage is dark.
children.example: The blackout after the judge’s verdict hides the courtroom as the performers leave.
children.translation_uz: sahna chiroqlari butunlay oʻchirilib, sahna qorongʻi qoladigan payt

children.definition: A gradual decrease in brightness until a light or group of lights goes out.
children.example: The fade-out of the light on the empty chair lets the image linger after the actor has left.

children.definition: Illumination directed across the stage from the left or right, often to emphasize the shape and movement of performers’ bodies.
children.example: Cool sidelight picks out the dancers’ raised arms as they turn together in the square.

children.definition: The angular width of a light beam. In fixture specifications it is often measured between the two points where intensity has fallen to half of its value at the centre.
children.example: The narrow beam angle keeps the light on the letter in the actor’s hand while the desk stays in shadow.

children.definition: A gradual transition from one lighting state to another. In a typical crossfade, some lights dim as others brighten.
children.example: During the crossfade, the amber light on the kitchen dims as blue light reveals the street.
children.translation_ru: плавный переход от одной световой картины к другой
children.translation_uz: bir yoritish holatidan boshqasiga asta-sekin oʻtish
collocations: a crossfade between two lighting states

children.definition: The direct line of view from a spectator’s position to a particular part of the stage.
children.example: A low lighting fixture blocked the sightline from the aisle seats to the dancer’s feet.
children.translation_uz: tomoshabinning koʻzidan sahnadagi muayyan nuqtagacha boʻlgan toʻgʻri chiziq
collocations: a clear sightline to the stage

children.definition: A designated overhead location where suspended equipment can be supported.
children.example: From the available rigging point, the fixture could illuminate the clock face above the actors.

children.definition: A thin, transparent filter that changes the color of light from a stage fixture.
children.example: An amber gel gives the light on the station steps the warm color of late afternoon.
children.translation_ru: цветной плёночный светофильтр для сценического прибора

children.definition: A dark shape with a clear outline and little visible detail, seen against a brighter background.
children.example: The performer appears in silhouette against the illuminated curtain before stepping into the light.

children.definition: A spotlight with a beam that can be steered to keep a moving performer lit.
children.example: The followspot stays on the soloist as she crosses the bridge above the chorus.
collocations: pick out a performer with a followspot

children.definition: A patterned insert used in a lighting fixture to project a shape or texture onto a surface.
children.example: A gobo projects a pattern of bare branches across the floor as the prisoner steps into the yard.
children.translation_ru: гобо, шаблон для проекции светового рисунка
children.translation_uz: gobo, sirtga yorugʻlik yordamida shakl yoki naqsh tushirish uchun chiroqqa oʻrnatiladigan andaza
collocations: project a pattern with a gobo

children.definition: The lights that illuminate the seating area of a theater.
children.example: The house lights come up at the interval as the actors freeze around the dinner table.
